question: Should OpenClaw continue supporting or backporting the legacy `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py --resources` helper, or close the linked PR and this issue as obsolete now that current main routes durable skill creation through `skill_workshop`?
rationale: Automation can verify the release parser is affected and the open PR fixes that old surface, but current main removed the helper and the skill instructions now point at a different creation workflow, which is a product-boundary choice.

options.title: Close obsolete cluster
options.body: Close the open PR and this issue together, documenting that current main no longer supports the initializer helper and `skill_workshop` is the supported path.

options.title: Refresh and land helper repair
options.body: Ask for or create a refreshed PR that intentionally restores or maintains the helper, adds the mixed-case parser tests, and explains whether this is a backport or supported current surface.

recommendation.title: Close obsolete cluster
recommendation.body: Close the open PR and this issue together, documenting that current main no longer supports the initializer helper and `skill_workshop` is the supported path.

likelyOwner.reason: The original bundled skill surface routes through `steipete` history, and the remaining choice is whether that legacy helper remains a supported product surface.
